name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to `http://localhost:3000` whenever the `PUBLIC_URL` environment variable isn't set, and password reset (and other) email links are built from that constant. In production, `PUBLIC_URL` is apparently missing or empty for these users, so the links point to localhost instead of the real app host. Fix should ensure `PUBLIC_URL` is set/validated in the production environment, and ideally have the app fail loudly (or default to a configured production URL) if it's absent, rather than silently falling back to localhost.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this value is used to build the password reset link (and other links) sent in emails. In production this env var is apparently missing or unset, so users receive reset links pointing at localhost instead of the real public URL.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/deployment configuration, and make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) when PUBLIC_URL is missing outside of local/dev environments, rather than silently defaulting to localhost. This prevents broken links from being sent out again if the env var is ever misconfigured.
